items.name: Baba Beach Club Natai
items.priceText: About 14,500-17,000 THB / night (~$430-510) for a Baba Suite (Jan 2026 rate). No Jan 2027 rate online yet. Circoloco nights cost much more.
items.whyStay: This is the Circoloco venue itself. You walk from your room to the party and back. A music hotel on the beach with a Funktion-One sound system, pool suites and villas.
items.description: Beach club hotel on Natai Beach in Phang Nga, run by the Sri panwa team. It has an entertainment pool, two restaurants, a beach club, suites, pool suites and pool villas. Music plays across the property, also in rooms, by design. Circoloco Thailand is here on Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan 2027.
items.nearby: Aleenta 8 min on foot. Airport about 35 min by car (25 km). Catch Beach Club (Bang Tao) about 50-60 min. Patong about 65-80 min.
tips: Circoloco runs here on Sat 9 and Sat 16 Jan 2027, 3 PM to 3 AM. Hotels nearby cost 2-3 times more on these nights, so book early.
Not for light sleepers: music plays across the hotel, also in the rooms.
Trip.com and Hotels.com list a deposit of 3,000 THB per night.

items.name: Aleenta Phuket Phang Nga Resort & Spa
items.priceText: About 19,400 THB / night (~$575) on weekdays. About 32,000-52,000 THB (~$950-1,540) on Circoloco weekend nights (9, 15 and 16 Jan).
items.whyStay: Quiet five-star resort next to Baba Beach Club. Walk to Circoloco in 8 minutes, then sleep in a calm suite. Nearly all rooms have a private pool.
items.description: All-suite resort on Natai Beach with about 67 rooms; nearly all have a private pool. There is a beachfront infinity pool, free beach cabanas, two restaurants and the Ayurah spa and wellness centre. The calm, upscale choice right next to the Circoloco venue.
items.nearby: Baba Beach Club 8 min on foot (600 m). Airport about 35 min by car. Few restaurants within walking distance.
tips: Prices jump 2-3 times on Circoloco nights. Tue 12 Jan cost about 19,400 THB.
Some room types are for guests 12+ only. Villas and residences take all ages.
Food at the hotel is expensive and there is little nearby. Plan your meals.

items.name: Natai House
items.priceText: About 1,700-2,600 THB / night (~$50-80). About 5,000 THB (~$150) on Fri 15 Jan; Sat 16 Jan showed no online rate.
items.whyStay: Small family-run resort 2 minutes from Natai Beach and 3 minutes by car from Baba Beach Club. A good-value base for Circoloco weekends, with a pool and breakfast.
items.description: Small, calm resort near Natai Beach, run by a local family. Guests praise the big clean rooms, the pool, the kind owners and the breakfast. One guest mentions insects in the room, and many nearby restaurants were closed at dinner time. A cheap, quiet base for Circoloco.
items.nearby: Natai Beach 2 min on foot. Baba Beach Club 3 min by car or 22 min on foot (1.7 km). Airport about 35 min by car.
tips: The hotel mainly uses Facebook. Booking sites are easier for reservations.
Circoloco ends at 3 AM. Arrange your ride back in advance.

items.name: The Snug Airportel
items.priceText: Dorm bed about 1,100 THB / night (~$33). Private rooms cost more.
items.whyStay: Hostel and hotel 4 minutes from the airport, with dorms, private rooms and two pools. A cheap base for your first or last night, and about 35 minutes by car to Circoloco.
items.description: Hotel and hostel near Phuket airport, open since 2018. It has dorms and private rooms in two wings, two pools, a restaurant and bar, luggage storage and a taxi service. Good for late arrivals, early flights, or a budget Circoloco base in the north.
items.nearby: Airport 4 min by car (1.9 km). Baba Beach Club about 35 min by car (27 km). Catch Beach Club about 25-30 min. Patong about 45-55 min.
tips: Luggage storage is available. Ask about leaving bags while you visit Koh Phangan.
The hotel taxi service costs extra. Ask at reception.

items.name: InterContinental Phuket Resort
items.whyStay: Five-star resort right on Kamala Beach, 4 minutes on foot from Café del Mar. Walk home after a big show. Five pools, a spa and beach bars.
items.description: Large luxury resort on Kamala Beach, between jungle hills and the sea. It has five outdoor pools, Sati Spa, a club lounge, pool villas and several bars, including Pine Beach Bar and a rooftop bar. The closest top hotel to Café del Mar.
items.nearby: Café del Mar 4 min on foot (320 m). Catch Beach Club about 10 min by car. Illuzion (Patong) about 20 min. Airport about 30-35 min.
tips: The most expensive pick in this list. Book early for January.
Club rooms include access to the club lounge.

items.name: Novotel Phuket Kamala Beach
items.whyStay: Four-star hotel with direct access to Kamala Beach, 6 minutes on foot from Café del Mar. Less than half the InterContinental price, with the same easy walk to the beach club.
items.description: Beachfront four-star hotel on Kamala Beach with rooms, suites and some private villas. It has a beachfront pool, the Soul Kitchen restaurant, the On The Roof bar, a spa and a gym. It is family-friendly, so expect children around the pool.
items.nearby: Café del Mar 6 min on foot (460 m). Catch Beach Club about 10 min by car. Illuzion (Patong) about 20 min by car.
tips: Watch the sunset at On The Roof, then walk to Café del Mar.
January rates are high for a Novotel. Compare with ibis Styles Bangtao.

items.name: Twinpalms Surin Beach Phuket
items.whyStay: Stylish design hotel a short walk from Surin Beach. Same group as Catch Beach Club, 5 minutes away by car. Central for Catch, Café del Mar and Niky's techno club.
items.description: Five-star design hotel built around a large lagoon pool, a short stroll from Surin Beach. It has rooms, suites and lofts; some penthouses have private pools. The Twinpalms group also runs Catch Beach Club on Bang Tao Beach.
items.nearby: Surin Beach 5 min on foot. Catch Beach Club 5 min by car (26 min on foot). Café del Mar and Niky's Speakeasy about 5 min by car. Patong about 20-25 min.
tips: Book on the Twinpalms site for direct-booking extras (2026: day cruise, 50% off airport transfers).
Baba Beach Club (Circoloco) is about 45-50 min north by car.

items.name: ibis Styles Phuket Bangtao
items.whyStay: New hotel (April 2026) with two rooftop infinity pools and a rooftop bar. 11 minutes on foot to Catch Beach Club and 3 minutes by car to Niky's techno club. Best value in the beach-club belt.
items.description: Colourful new hotel next to Laguna Phuket, opened in April 2026. It has 138 rooms, two rooftop infinity pools (one for kids), the Sun Flyer rooftop bar, an Italian restaurant and a gym. Early reviews are excellent. The beach is about 10-12 minutes on foot.
items.nearby: Catch Beach Club 11 min on foot (850 m). Niky's Speakeasy 3 min by car (18 min on foot). Café del Mar about 10 min by car. Airport about 25-30 min.
tips: Good base for Catch day parties and techno nights at Niky's Speakeasy.
It is new, so reviews are few (256) but the score is very high.

items.name: Hotel Indigo Phuket Patong
items.whyStay: Stylish boutique hotel in North Patong with a rooftop infinity pool. 12 minutes on foot to Shelter and Illuzion, so you can walk home after the club, but sleep away from Bangla Road.
items.description: Five-star boutique hotel in North Patong with design inspired by local life. It has The Cloud rooftop pool bar with an infinity pool, the Butcher's Garden restaurant, a tiki bar and a gym with a Thai boxing ring. It won Best Luxury Boutique Hotel in Asia at the 2026 Haute Grandeur awards.
items.nearby: Illuzion and Shelter 12 min on foot (900 m). Patong Beach 7 min on foot. Café del Mar about 15-20 min by car.
tips: Best Patong pick for walking home from Shelter late at night.
Go to the rooftop pool bar for sunset before the club.

items.whyStay: Good-value, reliable hotel in central Patong. 5 minutes on foot to the beach and 14 minutes to Shelter and Illuzion. Some rates include breakfast.
items.description: Large, simple chain hotel (about 270 rooms) in central Patong, with an outdoor pool and a kids' pool. Rooms are modern and practical. A safe mid-price base if you want the beach by day and the Bangla Road clubs at night.
items.nearby: Patong Beach 5 min on foot. Illuzion and Shelter 14 min on foot (1.1 km). Café del Mar about 15-20 min by car.
tips: Check that breakfast is included when you book.
Airport transfers cost extra.

items.priceText: About 7,500-10,200 THB / night (~$225-305). Several mid-January nights showed no online rate.
items.whyStay: Beachfront resort right on the sand at the south end of Kata Beach. Easy, relaxed beach days, and Patong's clubs are about 15-20 minutes away by car.
items.description: Four-star family resort directly on Kata Beach, part of the Beyond Hotels group. Rooms go from Superior to Seaview Suites, and some have direct pool access. Kata is a pretty bay with a relaxed mood and sunset views.
items.nearby: On Kata Beach. Illuzion (Patong) about 15-20 min by car. Nai Harn Beach about 15 min by car. Phuket Old Town about 25 min.

It is a family resort, so expect children.

items.priceText: About 8,400-12,200 THB / night (~$250-360). On Sat 16 Jan only pricier suites showed (about 25,600 THB).
items.whyStay: Romantic luxury boutique hotel on the headland above Kata Noi, with a private path to the beach. Thai-style suites, sea views and calm nights. A peaceful base between party days.
items.description: Small luxury boutique resort on a headland over Kata Noi Beach. It has 12 types of Thai-style suites, several with private pools, a saltwater pool in the rocks above the sea and two freshwater pools. Mom Tri's Kitchen serves food with sea views.
items.nearby: Kata Noi Beach a few minutes on foot (private path). Kata Beach 18 min on foot. Illuzion (Patong) about 15-20 min by car. Nai Harn about 15 min.
tips: Weekday nights cost much less than Saturdays.
The hotel restaurant is well known for seafood.

items.whyStay: Fun, art-themed hotel 4 minutes on foot from Karon Beach, with very good reviews. Cheaper than the Kata resorts, and Patong's clubs are only about 10-15 minutes away by car.
items.description: Art-themed, family-friendly hotel near Karon Beach, from the local Sugar Marina group. Rooms have art details, and some open straight onto the pool. Karon has a long, wide beach and is quieter than Patong at night.
items.nearby: Karon Beach 4 min on foot (300 m). Kata Beach about 5 min by car. Illuzion (Patong) about 10-15 min by car.
tips: Book a Premier Pool Access room to step straight into the pool.
Family-friendly, so expect children by the pool.

items.whyStay: Iconic white resort above Nai Harn Bay, 7 minutes on foot to Nai Harn Beach. Big sea-view terraces and a rooftop sunset bar, in the calm south of the island.
items.description: Five-star resort on the hillside over Nai Harn Bay, and Phuket's only Leading Hotels of the World member. Rooms and suites have large private terraces with sea views. Reflections Rooftop Bar and the Hansha rooftop sushi bar are good at sunset.
items.nearby: Nai Harn Beach 7 min on foot. Kata about 15 min by car. Illuzion (Patong) about 25-30 min. Phuket Old Town about 25-30 min.
tips: Book a sea-view room; the big terraces are the reason to stay.
The Bermudos crew (deep tech and techno) is linked to the Rawai and Nai Harn area, but its 2027 venue is not confirmed. Check its social pages.

items.description: Budget glamping site in Rawai. Choose a premium tent with AC and private bathroom, a fan tent, a shared tent or an 8-bed dorm. There is an infinity pool, chilled-out music in an open-air space, and Tojo's Cafe and Bar (open 8:30-21:30).

The beach is not close on foot. Rent a scooter or use Grab.

items.name: Casa Blanca Boutique Hotel
items.whyStay: Restored Sino-Portuguese shophouse hotel with a pool, in the heart of the Old Town. 4 minutes on foot to Thalang Road. Cheap, charming and close to cafes and street food.
items.description: Boutique hotel in restored old shophouses on Phuket Road in the Old Town. It has a garden, a coffee shop and a swimming pool. Rooms are Deluxe, Premium Deluxe and Family Suite. Good for culture, local food and the Sunday walking street.
items.nearby: Thalang Road 4 min on foot. Courage Bar (local underground nights) about 10 min on foot. Patong about 25-30 min by car. Airport about 40 min.

Follow @fake_palm and @subphuket on Instagram for underground parties at Courage Bar.

items.name: The Memory at On On Hotel
items.whyStay: Sleep in Phuket Town's first hotel, a 1927 Sino-Portuguese building on Phang Nga Road. History and style, with the Old Town's cafes, food and bars at your door.
items.description: Phuket Town's first hotel, built in 1927 by craftsmen from Penang in Sino-Portuguese style, now restored as The Memory. It is a two-storey landmark on Phang Nga Road in the Old Town. You can walk everywhere in the old quarter.
items.nearby: Thalang Road 6 min on foot. Courage Bar about 6 min on foot. Patong about 25-30 min by car. Airport about 40 min.
tips: On Sun 10 or Sun 17 Jan, the Lard Yai walking street runs on Thalang Road (16:00-22:00).

items.whyStay: Beachfront resort on Ban Tai beach with a pool. 5 minutes on foot to Chill Up, and 6-8 minutes by car to Halfmoon and OXA. A comfortable base for a Koh Phangan rave trip.
items.description: Mid-range resort on Ban Tai beach, Koh Phangan, with Cape Dutch style buildings, a garden, a beachfront pool and a beachfront restaurant. Rooms go from Urban Deluxe to an Oceanfront Pavilion. Ban Tai is the main area for the island's jungle parties.
items.nearby: Chill Up 5 min on foot (400 m). Halfmoon Festival about 6 min by car. OXA about 8 min by car. Thong Sala Pier about 6 min by car.

Taxis wait at the OXA exit until sunrise. Share one to pay less.

items.name: See Sea Backpackers
items.priceText: Dorm beds listed from about 200-270 THB / night (~$6-8) on undated listings. Expect more in January.
items.whyStay: Small, friendly hostel in Ban Tai, the closest pick to Halfmoon (4 minutes by car) and OXA (6 minutes). Top guest scores, cheap beds, and a calm place to sleep after the party.
items.description: Small, highly rated hostel in Ban Tai, about 900 m from the beach. Guests praise the owners and the relaxed, quiet mood. One guest says the 10-bed dorm feels crowded. Its own website is down, so book on Booking.com or Hostelworld.
items.nearby: Halfmoon Festival about 4 min by car (31 min on foot). OXA about 6 min by car. Chill Up 19 min on foot. Thong Sala Pier about 8 min by car.
tips: Book on Booking.com or Hostelworld. The hostel website does not work.
Ride a scooter only if you are experienced. At night, party taxis are safer.

items.description: Party hostel on Ban Tai beach with dorms, private rooms and tents. It has a pool, a beach bar and a gym. Guests praise the location and the manager. Some say it feels understaffed and the shared tent bathrooms are not always clean.
items.nearby: On Ban Tai beach. Thong Sala Pier 5 min by car. Chill Up 19 min on foot. Halfmoon about 9 min and OXA about 10 min by car.

notes:
24 hotels, resumed from the interrupted attempt and filled with targeted checks on 15 Oct 2026. Tiers: 7 luxury, 3 boutique, 8 mid-range, 2 budget, 4 hostel. Areas: Natai 3 (Baba, Aleenta, Natai House) plus the Snug Airportel near the airport as a budget Circoloco base; Kamala, Surin and Bang Tao 5; Patong 3; Kata, Kata Noi and Karon 3; Nai Harn and Rawai 3; Old Town 3; Koh Phangan (Ban Tai) 3.

PRICES: Google Hotels lowest offers for 1 night, checked 15 Oct 2026. Mainly Tue 12 and Sat 16 Jan 2027, plus 9, 10, 14 and 15 Jan from the earlier pass. Hotels use 2 adults; hostels use 1 adult, which gives the bed price. Google returned AED, converted at 15 Oct 2026 rates (1 USD = 33.63 THB = 3.6725 AED). Offers may exclude tax and service charge.

- Beyond Kata, Shunli and Natai House showed no rate for some dates. The text says "no online rate", not "sold out".
